briefdescription.para: Represents a drainage basin network constructed on a 3D terrain mesh.

detaileddescription.para: This class handles the construction and analysis of hydrological flow networks (receivers, streams, outlets) on a 3D triangular mesh. It allows simulating river network development, calculating Strahler orders, inverting receiver maps, breaching lakes, and updating elevations based on response times.
